expected.derivation: The description ('dried cassava, ground only, no other ingredient') does not read like a preparation of heading 19.01, although the SME declared 1901.20. The heading cannot be confirmed, so the 19.01 rule is not retrieved and no origin outcome is given. The adviser must confirm the HS code (Appendix IV covers heading 19.01 only; Annex 2, Art. 10 on classification). No food-aid input, so Art. 7(2) does not decide the case.
